title: D-091: Linux recertification of the supervisor after M0-T177 and M0-T178 (supersedes M0-T174)
objective: Recertify the supervisor controller on this Linux server at the tree that includes M0-T177 (B-027 systemd control-group containment and the self-kill fix) and M0-T178 (DB-103 equal-model refusal): pin the certified tools/agent_supervisor tree hash and the installed CLI identities, re-run the live claude-version teeth (capability_probe for claude and codex, native_adapter, event_bus S8), the shell-routing harness with mutants and the Linux containment suite, cite the CI real-unit R3 proof and the windows freeze baseline, recapture fixtures only if a CLI version changed, and write the certification report superseding M0-T174. All local probes; no provider call; no owner-typed step.
business_reason: Owner directive D-091: the moved loop is reviewed and certified before use (R007); M0-T177 and M0-T178 voided the M0-T174 certification.
inputs: project-control/reports/M0-T174-producer-report.md and M0-T174-DCV.md (the certification being superseded and its scope)

recaptured fixtures under tools/agent_supervisor/fixtures/ ONLY if an installed CLI version changed since M0-T174 (old fixtures kept)

creating /etc/nyc-supervisor/config.toml, record-manifest, or installing systemd units (owner-typed commissioning, M0-T175)

project-control/** except the producer report (orchestrator-only), .claude/**, .github/**, product code (services/**, apps/**, packages/**)
